description: This file contains the implementation of OrleansJsonSerializer class and multiple custom JSON converters for Orleans-specific types such as IPAddress, GrainId, ActivationId, SiloAddress, MembershipVersion, UniqueKey, IPEndPoint, and GrainReference. It provides serialization and deserialization support for Orleans internal types using Newtonsoft.Json.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializer
classes.description: Utility class for configuring JsonSerializerSettings to support Orleans types, providing methods for serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: IPAddressConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter implementation for IPAddress type, handling conversion to and from string representation.

classes.name: GrainIdConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter implementation for GrainId type, serializing and deserializing GrainId objects.

classes.name: ActivationIdConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter implementation for ActivationId type, serializing to and from its parsable string form.

classes.name: SiloAddressJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter implementation for SiloAddress type, handling serialization to and from its parsable string.

classes.name: MembershipVersionJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for MembershipVersion, serializing its value and deserializing from a long.

classes.name: UniqueKeyConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for UniqueKey, serializing to a hex string and deserializing from a string.

classes.name: IPEndPointConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for IPEndPoint, serializing address and port, and deserializing from JSON object.

classes.name: GrainReferenceJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for GrainReference, serializing reference details and deserializing to create a reference via a GrainReferenceActivator.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of the expected type using configured settings.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object into a JSON string using configured settings.

methods.name: CanConvert
methods.description: Checks if the converter can handle a specific type.
